FN-EJRXLC9-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 100
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Bryan Brinyark
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 100 as introduced could increase receipts to the Public Safety Fund by an estimated
maximum of $673,000 annually beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by authorizing the Alabama
Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) to increase the fee for certain background checks from either
$15 or $25, under current law, up to $30, as provided in this bill.
In addition, this bill could further increase the receipts to the Public Safety Fund by $12
annually beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, for each individual enrolled in the Alabama Rap Back
Program, which ALEA may establish pursuant to this bill. Per ALEA, these fees will offset any
costs incurred to administer the program.
Finally, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed.
